nodes.name: Cu-SnS2-x
aliases: Cu doped SnS2 with sulfur vacancies

nodes.name: Cu-SnS2-x hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: 0.3 mmol CuCl2·5H2O, 0.6 mmol of SnCl4·5H2O and 1.8 mmol of thioacetamide were added to 25 mL of ethanol and stirred to form a uniform solution. Then, the solution was transferred into a 50 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave. The autoclave was properly sealed and maintained at 160°C for 12 h. The autoclave was cooled down naturally to room temperature, and Cu·SnS2-x was harvested by centrifugation at 9000 rpm and washed three times with ethanol and dried under vacuum at 75°C overnight.

nodes.name: pristine SnS2 hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: Pristine SnS2 nanoflowers were prepared by the same procedure as Cu-SnS2-x but without the addition of CuCl2·5H2O: 0.6 mmol of SnCl4·5H2O and 1.8 mmol of thioacetamide were added to 25 mL of ethanol and stirred to form a uniform solution. Then, the solution was transferred into a 50 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave. The autoclave was properly sealed and maintained at 160°C for 12 h. The autoclave was cooled down naturally to room temperature, and pristine SnS2 was harvested by centrifugation at 9000 rpm and washed three times with ethanol and dried under vacuum at 75°C overnight.
